description: This PHP source file defines the AdmonitionParser class, which is responsible for parsing admonition blocks in Markdown content within a static site generator or Markdown parser framework. The class handles recognizing admonition syntax, managing its internal block structure, and parsing inline content such as titles.

classes.name: AdmonitionParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling custom admonition blocks in Markdown content, recognizing specific syntax, and creating internal block representations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with a specific type and optional title for the admonition block.

methods.name: getBlock
methods.description: Returns the internal AdmonitionBlock associated with this parser.

methods.name: isContainer
methods.description: Indicates that the parsed block can contain other blocks (returns true).

methods.name: canContain
methods.description: Determines if a given child block can be contained within this admonition block (always returns true).

methods.name: tryContinue
methods.description: Decides if the parser can continue the current block based on cursor position, handling indentation and blank lines.

methods.name: blockStartParser
methods.description: Returns an anonymous class that tries to identify the start of an admonition block based on specific syntax.

methods.name: parseInlines
methods.description: Parses inline content within the admonition's title if present.
